import pandas as pd, json
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
cols=[c for c in tr.columns if c!='outcome']

json.dump({'test_accuracy':round(float(acc),4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, random_state=42), default hyperparameters, trained on 80% stratified split',
 'notes':'Exact duplicate rows (57) were removed before a stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42) to avoid leakage. Zeros in insulin/skin_thickness were kept as-is, not imputed.'},open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
p=m.predict(h[cols]).astype(int)
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':p}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
print(acc, len(p), pd.Series(p).value_counts().to_dict())
"
